interpretation: every distribution is P(stat | the player appears); nothing here is an unconditional probability

pmf_construction.MIN: normal(mu = exponentially weighted mean of past minutes over appearances, half-life 5 appearances; sd = 6) discretised to integer minutes 0..70 (bins k-0.5..k+0.5, open ends)
pmf_construction.counts: negative binomial(mean = exponentially weighted per-appearance mean, half-life 5; dispersion r per target fitted by method of moments on all visible appearances, clipped to [1.5, 500]) over 0..k_max, tail mass folded into the top bin
pmf_construction.unknown_player: league pmf of the target over all visible appearances (+0.01 smoothing) when the player has no visible appearance
